alerts.title: SPY dominates ETF proposed targets
alerts.detail: SPY represents 100.0% of proposed targets. This checks fund exposure, not underlying issuer concentration or correlations.
alerts.review: Inspect underlying exposures and your intended allocation. One diversified ETF is different from one individual company.

alerts.title: SPY is below its 60-session average
alerts.review: Read the trend evidence and counterevidence. Sideways markets can repeatedly trigger this rule.

alerts.title: Macro context uses verified snapshots
alerts.detail: DFF, DGS2, DGS10, DFII10 are labelled official-page snapshots, not an automatic live macro feed.
alerts.review: Check observation dates in Sources & Methods. These snapshots are excluded from historical signals.

rules.name: VIX stress
rules.basis: Illustrative display bands. VIX is implied volatility, not a directional forecast or investable return.

rules.name: SPY realized volatility
rules.basis: 20-return sample volatility. Fixed review thresholds, not an optimized strategy.

rules.name: SPY one-session loss
rules.basis: Adjacent completed observations; backward-looking, not a future-loss prediction.

rules.name: SPY below 60-session average
rules.basis: A descriptive trend flag. It can whipsaw and does not require selling.

rules.name: Largest ETF target / holding
rules.basis: ETF-level exposure only, not issuer-level look-through, correlation or diversified portfolio risk.

rules.name: Replay drawdown budget use
rules.basis: Historical maximum drawdown divided by user budget. No automatic stop or guarantee.

rules.name: Market data age
rules.basis: Age above five calendar days, or a failed refresh, suppresses the affected current-market risk calculations.

coverage.portfolio: Proposed targets only; no live portfolio or broker connection

notice: These are review alerts from explicit heuristic rules, not validated forecasts, broker orders or a claim that unflagged portfolios are safe. Evaluated when data is loaded or replay advances; no background monitoring or push notifications.
